app.name: AutoLUT Palette
app.long_description:
Displays the 39 AutoLUT calibration colors fullscreen for capture color calibration.
Opens on a setup check screen with near-black and near-white boxes. Use it to confirm your capture card and OBS color range settings before calibrating. The AutoLUT guide explains how to read it.
Screenshot each color in OBS, then load the screenshots into AutoLUT to generate a color-correction LUT for your capture setup.
Controls (Wiimote or GameCube controller): LEFT/RIGHT - previous/next color A - next color B - toggle the setup check screen HOME/START - exit
